description: Na₃PO₃S crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent S and four equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.95 Å) and one longer (3.03 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.59 Å. P is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one S and three equivalent O atoms. The P-S bond length is 2.10 Å. All P-O bond lengths are 1.55 Å. S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Na and one P atom. O is bonded to four equivalent Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄P trigonal bipyramids.
